summary: Verified the gig booking calendar refactor on GigDetail. Old horizontal 14-day pill row is gone. shadcn CalendarUI (react-day-picker) now renders as a month grid with caption 'July 2026', chevron nav buttons, and grayed-out disabled/past dates. All 8 test cases from the review request pass.

test_results.case: gig-appt-calendar rendered as month grid (rdp root + caption 'July 2026' + chevrons), NO pill row (gig-appt-date-pill-0 not found)
Today (Jul 13) auto-selected on mount; day-summary shows 'Available slots for Mon, Jul 13'
gig-appt-slots renders 23 time buttons on auto-selected day
Next-month chevron (button[name=next-month]) advances caption twice: July -> August -> September (2 months ahead reachable)
Clicked Sep 16 (future ~65 days out); day-summary updated to 'Wed, Sep 16'; slot grid re-rendered with 23 buttons
Past dates (Jun 28-30, Jul 1-12) rendered as grayed rdp-day_disabled and non-selectable (fromDate=today enforces bound)

After selecting Sep 16 + 08:00 slot, book button became enabled (was disabled without both). Clicking gig-book-btn as signed-out user: this gig has booking_mode='whatsapp', so it opens WhatsApp deep link in new tab (per handleBookClick line 368-372), bypassing the /auth redirect. Auth redirect (line 374) only fires for non-whatsapp appointment gigs. Calendar->submit wiring is intact.

critical_code_review_comments: GigDetail.jsx is now 974 lines — should be split (AppointmentPicker, Lightbox, ProductCard, handleBookClick already are natural extraction candidates).

useEffect at line 794 depends only on firstAvailableIso but reads selectedDate/availableIsoSet/onSelectDate — ESLint react-hooks/exhaustive-deps would flag this. Deliberate to avoid re-seeding on every selection change, but consider a ref-guard or comment justifying the omission.
test_credentials: not needed — signed-out calendar flow tested
context_for_next_testing_agent: Calendar month-grid refactor on GigDetail is working end-to-end. Gig 3d4bb707... is whatsapp booking mode — the 'redirect to /auth on submit' criterion doesn't apply to it (it opens WhatsApp). For pure /auth-redirect verification you would need a non-whatsapp appointment gig.
